source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 2 Discovering Useful Structures:现在分词(V-ing)作状语(时间/原因·伴随/结果·see/hear/watch/find + sb + doing 作宾补,并与 done 被动对照)。句子地道、逻辑主语与主句一致;正确项为主动的现在分词,干扰项为 to do / done / having done。

points.point: V-ing 作时间/原因状语(= When/Because + 主语…)
points.overview: 现在分词放句首或句中,表示与主句同时或在先的动作/原因,逻辑主语 = 主句主语,且该主语主动发出动作时用 V-ing(Hearing the news, he rushed out.)。
现在分词表示与主句谓语同时发生的伴随动作,或自然而然产生的结果,常置于句末(She sat there, smiling. / The flood hit the town, leaving thousands homeless.),逻辑主语仍是主句主语。

points.point: see/hear/watch/find + sb + doing(宾补,主动进行) vs done(被动)
points.overview: 感官动词及 find 后接现在分词作宾补,强调宾语正在主动进行动作(I saw her whispering.);若宾语是动作的承受者则用过去分词 done(I saw the work done.)。

questions.stem: ____ the news that her mother had died, the little girl burst into tears.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 girl 主动'听到'、与哭泣几乎同时 → 现在分词 Hearing 作时间状语。

questions.stem: ____ of all the people still in need of help, Dr Lin opened a private clinic.
questions.explanation: Dr Lin 主动'想到',表原因 → Thinking。

questions.stem: ____ that his wife had been injured, Mr Johnson hurried to the hospital.
questions.explanation: Mr Johnson 主动听说、表原因 → 现在分词 Hearing。

questions.stem: ____ the high tuition fees, her brother thought she should not study so much.
questions.explanation: brother 主动'想到'学费、表原因 → Thinking of。

questions.stem: ____ higher import and export costs, the company is looking for ways to survive.
questions.explanation: the company 主动'面对'成本、表原因 → 现在分词 Facing。

questions.stem: ____ from the North Pole, the traveller wrote a book about his experience.
questions.explanation: traveller 主动'返回'、表时间(回来之后)→ Returning。

questions.stem: ____ the gold coins, the girl was greatly surprised but did not keep them.
questions.explanation: girl 主动'看见'、表时间 → Seeing。

questions.stem: ____ that many people were dying in the war, Dr Bethune left for China.
questions.explanation: Bethune 主动'听说'、表原因 → Hearing。

questions.stem: ____ that nothing good came from complaints, the king decided to teach a lesson.
questions.explanation: the king 主动'认为'、表原因 → Believing。

questions.stem: ____ deeply by her mother's death, Lin Qiaozhi later chose to study medicine.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Lin '被'母亲去世所影响,是动作承受者 → 过去分词 Affected(本题对照被动用法)。

questions.stem: ____ a stone in the road, the girl knew it was dangerous to others after dark.
questions.explanation: girl 主动'注意到'、表时间 → Noticing。

questions.stem: ____ to give up her dream, she told her brother she would rather stay single to study.
questions.explanation: she 主动'拒绝'、表原因 → Refusing。

questions.stem: ____ how kind the lady had been, the waitress decided to pass the kindness on.
questions.explanation: waitress 主动'记得'、表原因 → Remembering。

questions.stem: ____ his savings to a kindergarten, the old doctor felt at peace.
questions.explanation: the doctor 主动'留下'积蓄、表时间/伴随原因 → Leaving。

questions.stem: ____ low fees from poor patients, the kind doctor was loved by the whole town.
questions.explanation: the doctor 主动'收取'、表原因 → Charging。

questions.stem: ____ that the department had been closed, she set up a clinic of her own.
questions.explanation: she 主动'知道'、表原因 → Knowing。

questions.stem: ____ the same dilemma as the girl, many students could not decide what to do.
questions.explanation: students 主动'面临'、表时间/原因 → Facing。

questions.stem: ____ on a donkey to faraway villages, she brought medical care to the poor.
questions.explanation: she 主动'骑'驴、表时间 → Riding。

questions.stem: ____ how hard it was to help others, he still chose to volunteer every weekend.
questions.explanation: he 主动'明白'、表原因(让步)→ Understanding。

questions.stem: ____ a kind note under the change, the lady quietly left the café.
questions.explanation: the lady 主动'留下'纸条、表时间 → Leaving。

questions.stem: The child lay on her mother's lap, ____ sweetly to herself.
questions.explanation: 句末伴随状语,child 主动'微笑'与 lay 同时 → 现在分词 smiling。

questions.stem: She sat in the waiting room for over an hour, ____ about him.
questions.explanation: 句末伴随状语,she 主动'担心'与 sat 同时 → worrying。

questions.stem: The milkman crashed into the stone, ____ the milk everywhere.
questions.explanation: 结果状语,自然导致牛奶洒出 → 现在分词 spilling。

questions.stem: The flood hit the small town, ____ thousands of families homeless.
questions.explanation: 结果状语,洪水自然'使……无家可归'→ leaving。

questions.stem: He walked out of the café, ____ a note and the change for the waitress.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,he 主动'留下'与 walked 同时 → leaving。

questions.stem: Dr Lin worked day and night, ____ over 50,000 babies in her lifetime.
questions.explanation: 结果/伴随状语,主动'接生' → delivering。

questions.stem: The girl pushed the stone with all her might, finally ____ in moving it aside.
questions.explanation: 结果状语,自然导致'成功' → succeeding。

questions.stem: She picked herself up and limped away, ____ quietly all the way home.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,she 主动'哭'与 limped 同时 → crying。

questions.stem: The kind lady drove off, ____ the young waitress full of hope.
questions.explanation: 结果状语 → leaving。

questions.stem: He stood in front of the class, completely ____ the speech he had prepared.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,he 主动'忘记'与 stood 同时 → forgetting。

questions.stem: Dr Bethune travelled from village to village, ____ doctors and nurses on the way.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,主动'培训' → training。

questions.stem: The old man sat by the fire, ____ stories of kindness to the children.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,主动'讲'与 sat 同时 → telling。

questions.stem: The good news spread quickly through the town, ____ everyone hope again.
questions.explanation: 结果状语 → giving。

questions.stem: She bit her lip and walked away in silence, ____ to show her tears.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,主动'拒绝' → refusing。

questions.stem: The doctor reduced the costs again and again, often ____ nothing from the poor.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,主动'收取' → charging。

questions.stem: The young farmer's daughter rolled the stone aside, ____ the road safe for all.
questions.explanation: 结果状语,自然'使道路安全' → making。

questions.stem: The whole village watched in silence, slowly ____ the meaning of her act.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,主动'明白' → understanding。

questions.stem: He helped to organise hospitals, ____ people how to give first aid.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,主动'示范' → showing。

questions.stem: The chain of kindness went on and on, ____ from one stranger to the next.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,主动'传递' → passing。

questions.stem: The kind act warmed the whole town, ____ a small fire of hope in every heart.
questions.explanation: 结果状语 → lighting。

questions.stem: I saw her ____ something into his ear, obviously not wanting to be heard.
questions.explanation: see sb doing:宾语 her 主动'低语'、强调正在进行 → whispering。

questions.stem: The new People's Republic of China saw Dr Lin ____ a key role in medicine.
questions.explanation: see sb doing:Dr Lin 主动'发挥'作用 → playing。

questions.stem: He suddenly woke up when he heard someone ____ at his door.
questions.explanation: hear sb doing:someone 主动'敲门'、进行中 → knocking。

questions.stem: Seeing the tennis star ____ the court, the girl quickly picked up her camera.
questions.explanation: see sb doing:the star 主动'离开'球场 → leaving。

questions.stem: John watched the woman ____ to the air, thinking she might be unwell.
questions.explanation: watch sb doing:the woman 主动'说话'、进行中 → talking。

questions.stem: The king watched all day but found nobody ____ to move the stone.
questions.explanation: find sb doing:nobody 主动'尝试'、进行中 → trying。

questions.stem: At times Dr Lin was even seen ____ a donkey to faraway villages.
questions.explanation: be seen doing(被动后保留 doing):Dr Lin 主动'骑'驴 → riding。

questions.stem: We watched the milk ____ all over the street after the cart crashed.
questions.explanation: watch sth doing:milk 主动'流淌'、进行中 → spilling。

questions.stem: They were very proud to see their son ____ the university scholarship.
questions.explanation: see sb done:son 是'被授予'奖学金的承受者 → 过去分词 awarded(对照被动)。

questions.stem: She heard the children ____ happily in the next room and smiled.
questions.explanation: hear sb doing:children 主动'笑'、进行中 → laughing。

questions.stem: The crowd watched the young girl ____ the heavy stone with all her might.
questions.explanation: watch sb doing:girl 主动'推'、进行中 → pushing。

questions.stem: I found my little brother ____ over an old fable, deeply moved by the story.
questions.explanation: find sb doing:brother 主动'哭'、进行中 → crying。

questions.stem: The manager was pleased to find the job already ____ when he arrived.
questions.explanation: find sth done:the job 是'被完成'的承受者 → 过去分词 done(对照被动)。

questions.stem: The nurse saw tears ____ down the patient's face and gently held her hand.
questions.explanation: see sth doing:tears 主动'流淌'、进行中 → running。

questions.stem: He heard his name ____ across the hall just as he was about to leave.
questions.explanation: hear sth done:his name 是'被叫'的承受者 → 过去分词 called(对照被动)。

questions.stem: We could see the kind doctor ____ patients late into the night.
questions.explanation: see sb doing:doctor 主动'照料'、进行中 → tending。

questions.stem: She watched the lady ____ the change behind for the tired waitress.
questions.explanation: watch sb doing:lady 主动'留下'、进行中 → leaving。

questions.stem: The teacher found the whole class ____ in tears at the end of the sad story.
questions.explanation: find sb doing:class 主动'坐着'、状态进行中 → sitting。

questions.stem: The villagers saw the road ____ at last, thanks to one girl's kindness.
questions.explanation: see sth done:the road 是'被清理'的承受者 → 过去分词 cleared(对照被动)。

questions.stem: I often hear people ____ about small problems but doing nothing to fix them.
questions.explanation: hear sb doing:people 主动'抱怨'、进行中 → complaining。
